description: This file provides a backport implementation of the socket.makefile method from Python 3.5, allowing older Python versions to emulate this functionality for socket objects.

methods.name: backport_makefile( self, mode="r", buffering=None, encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None )
methods.description: Creates a file-like object from a socket, supporting modes, buffering, encoding, and other parameters similar to Python's socket.makefile().

ctags.name: backport_makefile
ctags.signature: ( self, mode="r", buffering=None, encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None )
